applies_why: The judge text addresses cited verses supporting a challenge and states that the point was answered, which is the situation the rule governs.
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
room: 'counts as an unanswered witness' — read as restricting only verses treated as unanswered support, versus read as restricting any mention of cited verses; under the first reading, this text is clean.
why: The judge expressly says the point was answered in [CR3] LINK 2, so under K-G4 the verse is not counted as an unanswered witness and no pressed-sentence quote is required.
